title: Call: SHL Courier Dispatch — Special Pickup Needs a Yes by 12:30

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - MCHD Nurse Manager Desk

transcript.speaker: SHL Dispatch
transcript.text: Hi, this is courier dispatch at the State Hygienic Lab, returning Marlow County's call about a pickup. Your next scheduled Marlow pickup is on Tuesday's run. That gets to you around 13:00 tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: SHL Dispatch
transcript.text: If you want it picked up today, I can send a special courier. He'd be at your building at about 14:00. Stools and food can ride in one cooler as long as they're packed separately and each item has its own custody paperwork. Food goes with your Environmental Health chain of custody forms, and stools go with the lab requisitions.

transcript.speaker: SHL Dispatch
transcript.text: How many are we talking about? Just so I know what size cooler to send. And are you sending more kits out today? If your folks need more Cary-Blair kits, he can bring a box with him.

transcript.speaker: SHL Dispatch
transcript.text: Okay. Before I dispatch, I need your Director's name on the authorization and a cost center to bill. Tell me by 12:30 or I can't make 14:00, and everything waits for tomorrow's run. Call me back on this line, 555-0142.

transcript.speaker: Text message, 11:07, MRMC Microbiology bench lead to Sunita Reddy
transcript.text: Three stools from Sunday ED are on enteric culture plus GI PCR. GI PCR on HD26-003 detected Salmonella at 10:52, so culture confirmation and the isolate are still pending. No culture read before mid-afternoon. Blood culture HD26-009: gram-negative rods, ID pending. If anything grows, the isolate will be held for referral to SHL.

voiceStyles.SHL Dispatch: Woman in her 50s, brisk and friendly, works from a dispatch desk and keeps one eye on the clock
voiceStyles.Nurse Manager: Played live by the Nurse Manager player

instructorNote: Play the call to the Nurse Manager, who has 4 filled Cary-Blair kits, 9 empty kits and 3 more cases asking for kits today. Then hand the 11:07 MRMC text to the Infection Preventionist. Watch for these steps: the Director authorizes the 14:00 courier (or doesn't) by 12:30. Laboratory priority goes to HD26-009 and the food handlers first, and the decision is logged under MOISOP 8. EH packs the coleslaw, pasta salad and raw thighs under chain of custody. The IP phones the PCR result to the Epi Lead. HD26-003 is now PCR-positive but not culture-confirmed, so it should not be moved to the confirmed tier without a definition decision.
